title: Mitosis architecture audit and rebuild exploration

completion_criteria.text: Foundational audit of the current engine complete across all four domains: two-layer fan-out, durability/resume, cost/latency, pipeline rigidity + fragility
External research verdict delivered on whether the architecture is correct, with disconfirming pass and cited prior art
The child_process runtime-capability question settled empirically (does dynamic import of node:child_process EXECUTE inside a Workflow script, not merely resolve)

Three open architecture decisions resolved by the user: adopt an off-the-shelf durable-execution runtime vs only its state model; default speculation depth given that rework costs tokens not machine time; which work-type pipelines to define first
An approved architecture spec for the rebuild exists, superseding or explicitly scoping the six paused repair-oriented mitosis threads

spine.active_goal: The step-6 rebuild spec EXISTS at docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-30-mitosis-core-rebuild.md - 15 sections, 14 MSPs, a falsifier on every MSP, every line citation re-verified against the live tree on 2026-07-30. The spec-first gate set by the user is now SATISFIED and retired. Immediate goal: IMPLEMENT that spec, landing MSP-0 then MSP-1 before any collapse MSP, per explicit user directive given at hand-off.
spine.next_step: IMPLEMENT the spec at docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-30-mitosis-core-rebuild.md, per explicit user directive. open_risks: Spec section 2 hard preconditions (step 0 reaper, step 1 sandbox harness, step 1.5 streaming flip, step 2 twinning removal, step 3 state model and journal) are ASSUMED landed and were NOT verified this session. Verify by execution before MSP-0, or the sequence repeats the 0103 mistake 0107 caught.

Every MSP writes under .claude/{lib,workflows}, which the write guard holds for human approval per write - implementers cannot be fanned out unattended; plan interactive approval or land a carve-out first.
The spec is UNCOMMITTED and untracked on feat/centralized-pr-creation; committing it there pollutes that branch's PR-creation diff. Branch choice is the first decision of the next session.
12 leaked worktrees / 78 MB remain a LIVE TRIPWIRE (a checked-out branch blocks branch -f). hermetic-guard-test holds an UNCOMMITTED modified tracked file - human call needed.
Second-system effect (0106) is still the primary danger: the spec adds 10 verbs to a 3-verb surface (6 prose transcriptions, 4 new capability). Mitigation is narrowing, never more reviewers.

MSP-12 (pipeline-as-data) rests on 0106's ONLY below-HIGH claim (MEDIUM-HIGH); its falsifier - any stage needing a closure over run state - is the sharpest in the spec and must be run early, not at the end.
LSP seeding is a silent-failure surface (0120): an unseeded query returns a PLAUSIBLE NON-EMPTY answer missing every cross-file edge. The canary receipt asserting BOTH halves is mandatory.
Three performance claims (8 round trips to 3 or 2; census 100 to 57; token drop) stay LABELLED UNMEASURED until MSP-1 produces a baseline on the current engine, per 0125.
record_decision DROPS the largest parameter on oversized payloads - keep decision outcomes under roughly 2500 characters. update_thread caps next_step at 500.
Dirty tree on feat/centralized-pr-creation: modified .drift-state.json, a test, mitosis.js; untracked .bak twins and three specs including this one.
Six other paused mitosis threads still need explicit per-thread disposition from the user.
out_of_scope: Pipelines for refactor, perf, docs or chore - closed by 0118. Limits PIPELINES only, not the PR title type vocabulary.
The feat pipeline - 0110 sequences it second, after the fix pipeline proves the effector boundary and durability model against a machine-checkable oracle.

Bootstrapping a target repo's test infrastructure as a side effect of shipping - closed by 0117; that is verify-setup, human-invoked.
Adopting an off-the-shelf durable-execution runtime - closed by 0108. A webhook, server or daemon for the relaunch trigger - closed by 0119.
fileScope-only task-edge derivation - rejected by 0116, settled by 0120: edges derive from a deterministic verb driving LSP over a seeded project.
Cluster-aware scheduling, and the journal's 2000-char model-output paging - real defects, but they change the scheduler and step 3 respectively; spec section 1 fences both out.
Executing the run-readiness-repair spec's 11 MSPs or quiescent-advance M0-M8, pending per-thread disposition. Dispatching or restarting any target-repo mitosis run.
